import openpyxl, os
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook(os.environ['OUT_XLSX'])
ws=wb.active
hdr=ws['S4'].value
start=ws['S6'].value
end=ws['S8'].value
col=None
for c in range(1,ws.max_column+1):
    if ws.cell(row=2,column=c).value==hdr:
        col=c
        break
rstart=rend=None
for r in range(3,ws.max_row+1):
    if ws.cell(row=r,column=1).value==start:
        rstart=r
    if ws.cell(row=r,column=1).value==end:
        rend=r
tot=0
for r in range(rstart,rend+1):
    v=ws.cell(row=r,column=col).value
    if isinstance(v,(int,float)):
        tot+=v
ws['S10']=tot
wb.save(os.environ['OUT_XLSX'])
print('done',tot)
